_comment: CallX — Firebase Realtime Database Security Rules (Verification badge)
_instructions: 1. Install Firebase CLI: npm install -g firebase-tools
2. Login: firebase login
3. Merge the 'rules' section below into your existing Firebase DB rules.
4. Deploy: firebase deploy --only database
OR paste manually into Firebase Console → Realtime Database → Rules tab.
SECURITY MODEL:
• verification_requests — a top-level '.read' grants admins the
orderByChild('status') query the :admin app runs (RTDB requires
read permission at the exact path being queried, not just at each
child) — .indexOn ['status'] keeps that query server-side/fast
instead of the SDK warning + client-side filtering it'd otherwise do.
• verification_requests/{uid} — the OWNER can create/update their own
request (submitting a new request or editing while still pending).
Only an admin (present under admins/{adminUid}) can set 'status' to
'approved'/'rejected' — enforced via the .validate rule on that field.
• admins/{uid} — read-only to everyone signed in (so a client can
check 'am I an admin'); writes are NOT allowed from any client at
all — an admin is added by hand via the Firebase console (or the
Admin SDK from a trusted backend), never from the :admin app itself.
This keeps 'who can grant verification' outside app-layer reach.
• users/{uid}/isVerified — only an existing admin can set this to
true/false; the owning user cannot self-verify.
SETUP: the very first admin has no admins/{uid} entry to check against,
so it can't be created from a client per the rule above. Add the first
admin manually once, in the Firebase Console → Realtime Database →
your data → admins → +  → key: <that person's uid>, value: true.
